# Batch / refactor tools

8 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `find_by_node_type`

Search all scenes in the project for nodes of a given built-in class (e.g. Sprite2D, MeshInstance3D). For custom GDScript classes use find_by_script instead. Returns a list of {scene, node_path, node_name, node_type} matches.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_type` | `string` | yes | Built-in Godot class name to search for (e.g. 'Sprite2D', 'CharacterBody3D'). |
| `scene_filter` | `string` | — | Optional substring to filter scene paths (e.g. 'levels/' searches only scenes in a levels folder). |
| `include_inherited` | `boolean` | — | If true (default), also match subclasses of the given type. |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum number of results to return (default 500). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-01:

```json
{
  "node_type": "Label"
}
```

## `find_by_script`

Search all scenes for nodes that have a specific GDScript file attached. Returns a list of {scene, node_path, node_name, node_type} matches.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `script_path` | `string` | yes | res:// path to the script file (e.g. 'res://scripts/player.gd'). |
| `scene_filter` | `string` | — | Optional substring to filter scene paths. |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum number of results to return (default 500). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-03:

```json
{
  "script_path": "res://tests/test_example.gd"
}
```

## `find_by_group`

Search all scenes for nodes that belong to a specific node group. Returns a list of {scene, node_path, node_name, node_type} matches.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `group_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the group to search for (e.g. 'enemies', 'pickups'). |
| `scene_filter` | `string` | — | Optional substring to filter scene paths. |
| `max_results` | `integer` | — | Maximum number of results to return (default 500). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-02:

```json
{
  "group_name": "test_group"
}
```

## `bulk_rename`

Rename nodes whose names match a pattern. In 'current_scene' scope, uses UndoRedo (Ctrl+Z supported). In 'all_scenes' scope, modifies and re-saves scene files directly (no UndoRedo). Use dry_run:true in all_scenes mode to preview changes before saving.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `match` | `string` | yes | Substring (or regex pattern if regex:true) to find in node names. |
| `replacement` | `string` | yes | Replacement string. For regex mode, supports backreferences ($1, $2, etc.). |
| `regex` | `boolean` | — | If true, treat 'match' as a regular expression (default false). |
| `scope` | `string` | — | Where to apply renames. Default: current_scene. One of: `"current_scene"`, `"all_scenes"`. |
| `scene_filter` | `string` | — | Only used when scope is 'all_scenes'. Substring to filter which scene files to process. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | — | Only used when scope is 'all_scenes'. Preview changes without saving (default false). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-06:

```json
{
  "match": "LabelA",
  "replacement": "TextA",
  "scope": "current_scene"
}
```

## `cross_scene_update`

Update a property on all nodes of a given type across multiple scene files. Use dry_run:true to preview which nodes would be changed before committing. Note: scenes are instantiated and re-packed, bypassing UndoRedo.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_type` | `string` | yes | Built-in class name of nodes to update (e.g. 'Label', 'AudioStreamPlayer'). |
| `property` | `string` | yes | Property name to set on each matching node (e.g. 'modulate', 'volume_db'). |
| `value` | any | yes | New value to assign to the property. |
| `scene_filter` | `string` | — | Optional substring to filter which scene files to process. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | — | If true, return which nodes would be updated without saving (default false). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-07:

```json
{
  "node_type": "Label",
  "property": "text",
  "value": "Hi MCP",
  "dry_run": true
}
```

## `find_dependencies`

List the resources that a given resource or scene depends on. With recursive:true, returns the full transitive dependency tree.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `resource_path` | `string` | yes | res:// path to the resource or scene to inspect (e.g. 'res://scenes/player.tscn'). |
| `recursive` | `boolean` | — | If true, follow dependencies transitively and return the full dependency tree (default false). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-04:

```json
{
  "resource_path": "res://test_batch.tscn"
}
```

## `orphaned_resources`

Find resources in the project that are not referenced by any scene or other resource. Useful for cleaning up unused assets. By default scans .tres, .res, and .gdshader files.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `extensions` | `array` | — | File extensions to check for orphans (default: ['.tres', '.res', '.gdshader']). Array items are `string`. |
| `include_scripts` | `boolean` | — | Also include .gd script files in the orphan check (default false). |
| `include_scenes` | `boolean` | — | Also include .tscn scene files in the orphan check (default false). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-05:

```json
{}
```

## `refactor_signals`

Rename signal handler method connections across scene files. Finds all signal connections that call 'old_method' and rewires them to 'new_method'. Use dry_run:true to preview changes. Note: bypasses UndoRedo.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `old_method` | `string` | yes | Current method name that signals are connected to (e.g. '_on_button_pressed'). |
| `new_method` | `string` | yes | New method name to rewire the signal connections to. |
| `signal_name` | `string` | — | Optional: only refactor connections for a specific signal name. |
| `scene_filter` | `string` | — | Optional substring to filter which scene files to process. |
| `dry_run` | `boolean` | — | If true, report which connections would change without saving (default false). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/19-batch.json`, test BR-08:

```json
{
  "old_method": "_on_btn_pressed",
  "new_method": "_on_button_pressed",
  "dry_run": true
}
```
